pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/stagger.tsx:256 A module-scoped cache of measured part heights, keyed by part@innerWidth x innerHeight (line 258), with no size cap and no reaper other than the forgetSizes test hook. Every distinct window size seen during a resize adds entries for the window's lifetime, which breaks the bounded-eviction rule for derive caches.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/stagger.tsx:256 Unbounded module-level derived-value cache. The rule asks for a small cap on recently used entries; only a test reset exists (line 260).
